phrases.latin: Hauriētis aquās in gaudiō dē fontibus salvātōris.
phrases.english: You shall draw water with joy from the springs of salvation; for the walk to a village spring

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 38.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
